messages:
maya: heads-up: during qtrace onboarding for otter-lite-q4 we observed funcall responses with the \"tools\" field being a single escaped string instead of an array (breaks strict SDK parser). sample below.
tony: when did this start? PTQ run or infra change?
maya: right after the q4 quant pass + a batching tweak. repro curl: 
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{\"model\":\"otter-lite-q4\",\"prompt\":\"call tools\",\"max_tokens\":80}'\n```
bad (truncated):
```\n{\"id\":\"r101\",\"output\":\"{\\\"tools\\\": \\\"[\\\"search\\\", \\\"summarize\\\"]\\\"}\n\"}\n```
so tools is a JSON-encoded string. downstream parser fails and we end up exhausting retry budget.
zara: can we rescue in SDK? detect stringified JSON for tools and attempt safe unescape+parse, but must flag telemetry. Also do not auto-retry side-effecting endpoints.
maya: I'll add a canary lint that fails onboarding if >0.5% of samples have stringified tools. deploy-bot: Canary job 4423456789-otter-lite-q4 created. status: running.
tony: also check streaming vs non-streaming, and deterministic temp 0.0. if both reproduce then likely decode/tokenizer remap.
maya: reproduced both streaming and non-streaming at temps 0 and 0.5.
zara: short-term: block otter-lite-q4 from production contract routes and fall back to otter-fp16. long-term: instrument token-level dumps around the contract boundary and add a post-process sanitizer in the runtime to catch escaped-json patterns.
tony: add metric stringified_tools_count and sample N examples to the eval board. also limit retries from SDK when rescue parser used.
maya: plan: 1) add SDK rescue + telemetry, 2) lint canary to fail on >0.5%, 3) golden-run diff vs fp16, 4) follow-up quant recipe tweak. posting results when ready.
zara: thanks. ping if you see similar on other models.
